title: Software Developer (Core PHP, Drupal and WordPress) role
description:
**Experience:** 
 2–3\+ Years
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Location:** 
 Based on company policy
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Hybrid
 



**Shift Timings:** 
 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM, also flexible when needed
 



**Must\-Have Skills:** 
 Core PHP, Drupal, WordPress, MySQL
 



**Candidate Requirement:** 
 Local candidates only – Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar
 



  





**Job Summary:**




 We are looking for a passionate and skilled
 **Software Developer** 
 with 2\+ years of experience in PHP\-based web application development, Drupal customization, and WordPress development.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in CMS development, custom plugin/module development, website optimization, security best practices, and database management.
 



 The candidate should be capable of handling complete
 **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)** 
 activities, including requirement analysis, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and client communication.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Develop, customize, and maintain web applications using Core PHP.
* Develop and maintain Drupal themes and modules.
* Design and develop custom WordPress themes and plugins.
* Customize and extend existing WordPress plugins and themes.
* Build responsive and user\-friendly websites using Elementor and WPBakery.
* Optimize website performance, speed, and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement WordPress and Drupal security best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues efficiently.
* Write clean, scalable, reusable, and well\-documented code.
* Create and optimize MySQL database structures and queries.
* Integrate third\-party APIs, payment gateways, and external services.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, QA teams, and project managers.
* Perform code reviews and ensure coding standards are followed.
* Deploy and maintain applications on Linux/Ubuntu servers.
* Manage hosting environments and control panels such as cPanel, Plesk, DirectAdmin, CyberPanel, or similar.
* Ensure websites are SEO\-friendly and technically optimized.
* Participate in project planning, estimation, and sprint activities.
* Maintain project documentation and technical specifications.



  





**Required Technical Skills:**




  





 PHP Development
 


* Strong knowledge of Core PHP
* Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* MVC Architecture concepts
* REST API development and integration
* JSON, AJAX, Web Services



  





 Drupal Development
 


* Theme Customization \& Development
* Module Customization \& Development
* Drupal Site Building
* Drupal Configuration Management



  





 WordPress Development
 


* Custom Theme Development
* Theme Customization
* Custom Plugin Development
* Plugin Customization
* WordPress Hooks (Actions \& Filters)
* Custom Post Types (CPT)
* Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
* Elementor Development
* WPBakery Development
* WooCommerce Customization
* WordPress Security Best Practices
* Website Migration \& Maintenance
* Website Performance Optimization



  





 Frontend Development
 


* HTML5
* CSS3
* Bootstrap
* JavaScript
* jQuery
* Responsive Web Design
* Cross\-browser Compatibility



  





 Database
 


* MySQL
* Query Optimization
* Database Design
* Stored Procedures (Preferred)



  





 SEO \& Performance
 


* Technical SEO
* Core Web Vitals Optimization
* Schema Markup
* Website Audits
* Speed Optimization Tools



  





 Server \& Hosting
 


* Ubuntu/Linux Basics
* Apache/Nginx Configuration
* SSL Installation
* DNS Management
* cPanel/Plesk/CyberPanel/DirectAdmin
* Git Version Control



  





 Preferred Additional Skills
 


* Laravel Framework (Basic to Intermediate)
* CodeIgniter Framework
* Docker Basics
* CI/CD Concepts
* GitHub / GitLab / Bitbucket
* Redis Cache
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, DigitalOcean, Azure)
* Moodle CMS Knowledge
* AI Tools for Development Productivity
* Basic DevOps Concepts



  





 Soft Skills
 


* Good Communication Skills
* Strong Problem\-Solving Ability
* Analytical Thinking
* Team Collaboration
* Client Interaction Skills
* Time Management
* Self\-Learning Attitude
* Attention to Detail
* Ability to Work Under Deadlines



  





 Knowledge \& Process Understanding
 


* Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Agile/Scrum Methodology
* Requirement Gathering
* Software Documentation
* Testing \& Quality Assurance Concepts
* Version Control Best Practices
* Security Standards \& Coding Guidelines



  





 Education
 


* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MCA, BCA, BE/B.Tech, or equivalent.



  





 Preferred Candidate Profile
 


* 2–3\+ years of hands\-on experience in PHP and CMS development.
* Proven experience working on Drupal customization projects.
* Proven experience in WordPress plugin/theme development.
* Strong understanding of database optimization and website performance.
* Ability to independently handle development tasks and client requirements.
* Portfolio of live websites/projects will be an added advantage.
